name: Talisman of Power
body:
Aura strong (no design); CL 10th; Slot none Weight —; Price varies; 1,000 gp (1st), 4,000 gp (2nd), 9,000 gp (3rd), 16,000 gp (4th), 25,000 gp (5th), 36,000 gp (6th), 49,000 gp (7th), 64,000 gp (8th), 81,000 gp (9th)

DESCRIPTION

A talisman of power is a small talisman, usually made out of metal or stone, that has runic symbols etched onto its surface. It contains runic power within its surface, allowing a scribe to cast more scripts per day than normal.

Once per day on command, a talisman of power enables the possessor to recall any one script that he knows and has cast at least once that day. The chosen script regains one of its daily castings for the day. The script must be of a particular level, depending on the talisman. Different talismans exist for recalling one script per day of each level from 1st through 9th.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be able to cast runic scripts of the script level to be recalled; Cost varies; 500 gp (1st); 2,000 gp (2nd); 4,500 gp (3rd); 8,000 gp (4th); 12,500 gp (5th); 18,000 gp (6th); 24,500 gp (7th); 32,000 gp (8th); 40,500 gp (9th)
